title: Which Stock Would AI Choose? Cipher Digital Inc. (CIFR) vs. IREN Limited (IREN) Stock Comparison
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
* Cipher Digital Inc. (CIFR) and IREN Limited (IREN) are both pivoting from Bitcoin mining toward high-performance computing (HPC) and AI data center operations, exposing them to similar growth drivers in the expanding AI infrastructure sector.
* IREN Limited (IREN) reported substantial new AI cloud contracts valued at $2.8 billion in July 2026 and raised its 2026 annualized run-rate revenue (ARR) target above $4 billion, with approximately 85% under contract.
* Cipher Digital Inc. (CIFR) accelerated delivery of its Black Pearl data center and secured project-level financing, including support for a Texas site, while navigating regulatory reviews and reporting a larger-than-expected Q2 2026 loss.
* Market capitalization for IREN Limited (IREN) stands notably higher than that of Cipher Digital Inc. (CIFR), reflecting differences in scale, revenue base, and recent contract momentum.
* Both stocks have exhibited high volatility tied to Bitcoin prices, AI demand signals, and sector sentiment, with performance influenced by broader market activity in recent weeks.
* Relative positioning favors companies demonstrating contracted AI revenue visibility and operational scale in the current environment.
